items.name: Structural-Vector-Autoregression-Modeling
items.description: I analyze the interplay of three U.S. time series: unemployment, inflation and gross domestic product. The first cleans the data and invests seasonality and stationarity. The second part  develops a (structural) vector autoregressive model and test structural identification. The third uses principal compnent analysis and three different quality criterions to forecast quarterly U.S. GDP.

items.name: Time-Varying-Parameter-Structural-Vector-Autoregression-Model-With-Exogenous-Variables
items.description: The model follows Primiceri (2005)–style prior selection but does not impose OLS-based priors. Innovation variances for coefficient paths are treated as equal and constant across both endogenous and exogenous coefficients, unlike the time-varying specification in Primiceri (2005).

items.name: Using-short-run-restrictions-for-the-effect-of-a-monetary-policy-shock
items.description: In this projects I will make use of a structural Vector Autoregression model to consider the effect of a policy rate shock on output and inflation in Italy, considering observations from 1999 until 2021.

items.name: Energy-Price-Shocks-and-Canadian-Inflation-
items.description: Using a Structural Vector Autoregression (SVAR) identified via a Cholesky decomposition, I examined whether the Canadian central bank reacts immediately to energy shocks or delays intervention until these pressures pass through to core inflation.
